name: major
rule: Consumer requires exact major 24.

name: minor
rule: Consumer accepts exact minor 0 only.

name: pointer_width
rule: Only 64-bit targets are legal.

name: endianness
rule: Value 1 means little-endian; all others reject.

name: wln_status_v24
rule: Zero is success; listed negative values are failures; positive and unknown values reject.

name: wln_borrowed_buffer_v24
rule: Caller retains storage and immutability for call duration; library never frees or retains it.

name: data
rule: NULL iff length is zero; points to length readable bytes.

name: length
rule: At most 268435456; checked before pointer arithmetic.

name: wln_owned_buffer_v24
rule: Returned nonempty storage is released only by wln_result_release_v24 or wln_diagnostic_release_v24; context release never releases caller-held output.

name: data
rule: NULL iff capacity is zero; never caller-freed directly.

name: length
rule: At most capacity and the field-specific cap.

name: capacity
rule: Allocator allocation size; at least length.

name: owner_cookie
rule: Nonzero live cookie is authenticated and bound to exact mapped-library generation allocator record and allocation; copied cookies do not create ownership.

name: wln_handle_v24
rule: Created once and released once; stale generation rejects.

name: value
rule: Zero is invalid.

name: generation
rule: Nonzero and matched against library handle table.

name: wln_allocator_v24
rule: Caller retains struct callbacks and context through failed-create diagnostic release and until every associated handle result and diagnostic cookie is released.

name: struct_size
rule: Exactly 64.

name: flags
rule: Exactly zero in minor 0.

name: context
rule: Opaque caller context.

name: allocate
rule: Required; returns aligned storage or NULL.

name: reallocate
rule: Required for frozen struct layout but never called by ABI v24 minor-0 private staging; NULL retains old storage and successful non-NULL completion consumes old storage so no later old-address read write zero or free is permitted.

name: free
rule: Required; receives the exact allocation size and alignment.

name: reserved
rule: All zero on input and output.

name: wln_call_context_v24
rule: Valid only for the dynamic extent of one create or invoke call.

name: struct_size
rule: Exactly 96.

name: abi_major
rule: Exactly 24; every other value including 13, 14, 15, and 19 is WLN_STATUS_ABI_MISMATCH_V24 before callback or output write.

name: abi_minor
rule: Exactly 0.

name: flags
rule: Exactly zero in minor 0.

name: reserved0
rule: Zero.

name: allocator
rule: Required and points to a valid wln_allocator_v24 retained through context release.

name: is_cancelled
rule: Optional; NULL means unavailable; 0 continues 1 cancels and 2 through 255 are callback-protocol errors at each of five safe-point classes; no exception or unwind crosses the C boundary.

name: cancel_context
rule: Must be NULL when is_cancelled is NULL; otherwise retained through every associated owner and serialized by exact callback/context domain.

name: relative_timeout_ns
rule: Zero disables the deadline; otherwise 1 through 3600000000000 nanoseconds captured against the native RID clock at call entry.

name: trace_id
rule: All zero means absent; otherwise opaque and never security-authoritative.

name: reserved
rule: All zero.

name: wln_diagnostic_v24
rule: Caller uses WLN_DIAGNOSTIC_INIT_V24; library returns canonical empty diagnostic or bounded owned fields; dedicated release zeroes the complete struct.

name: struct_size
rule: Exactly 96 for an output parameter; a complete all-zero struct is legal only as an already-released input to wln_diagnostic_release_v24.

name: domain
rule: Exactly the Section-5.2 mapping: 0 success 1 ABI 2 KERNEL or 3 SYSTEM; no other domain exists.

name: severity
rule: Exactly zero for success or 3 for every completed error; 1 and 2 are unassigned.

name: code
rule: Exactly zero for success or the unique Section-5.2 code for status; alternate same-domain codes reject.

name: flags
rule: Exactly zero; sensitive-message/context bits remain declared for ABI layout compatibility but no v24 diagnostic may set them.

name: message
rule: Success is canonical empty; completed error is the exact nonempty ASCII message for status in Section 5.2 with one live owner cookie.

name: context
rule: Always canonical empty NULL zero zero zero; v24 defines no diagnostic context type or fields.

name: reserved
rule: All zero.

name: wln_result_v24
rule: Caller uses WLN_RESULT_INIT_V24; PRE_DISPATCH_NO_WRITE leaves all bytes identical and has no release while exactly one release follows each COMPLETED_OWNED_RESULT success or failure.

name: struct_size
rule: Exactly 160 for invoke output; a complete all-zero struct is legal only as an already-released input to wln_result_release_v24.

name: status
rule: For a completed result matches function return exactly; pre-dispatch rejection leaves initializer status OK byte-identical and is not a result.

name: operation
rule: A completed result echoes one known operation 1 through 3; unknown operations leave initializer operation zero byte-identical and create no result.

name: flags
rule: Exactly zero in minor 0.

name: payload
rule: Success uses exact operation output CBE16; failure is canonical empty.

name: diagnostic
rule: Success is canonical empty; failure is a bounded error diagnostic.

name: reserved
rule: All zero.

name: wln_abi_descriptor_v24
rule: Immutable storage valid for library mapping lifetime; consumer never frees pointers.

name: struct_size
rule: Exactly 128.

name: abi_major
rule: Exactly 24; every other value including 13, 14, 15, and 19 is ABI_MISMATCH before context creation.

name: abi_minor
rule: Exactly 0.

name: pointer_width
rule: Exactly 8.

name: endianness
rule: Exactly 1 for little-endian.

name: status_width
rule: Exactly 4.

name: flags_width
rule: Exactly 4.

name: feature_flags
rule: Exactly zero in minor 0.

name: max_input_bytes

name: max_output_bytes
rule: Exactly 268435456.

name: abi_header_sha256
rule: Points to exactly 32 bytes matching this header file.

name: abi_layout_sha256
rule: Points to exactly 32 bytes matching this TSV file.

name: shared_identity_digest

name: shared_identity_digest_length
rule: Exactly 32.

name: reserved0
rule: Zero.

name: reserved_identity

name: reserved
rule: All zero.

name: WLN_STATUS_OK_V24
rule: Only success value.

name: WLN_STATUS_INVALID_ARGUMENT_V24
rule: Null, size, alias, reserved, or ownership precondition failed.

name: WLN_STATUS_ABI_MISMATCH_V24
rule: Major, minor, layout, or descriptor mismatch.

name: WLN_STATUS_INVALID_ENCODING_V24
rule: CBE16 or operation grammar invalid.

name: WLN_STATUS_LIMIT_EXCEEDED_V24
rule: Declared cap exceeded before allocation.

name: WLN_STATUS_AUTHORITY_REJECTED_V24
rule: Trust, membership, threshold, or policy rejected.

name: WLN_STATUS_CRYPTOGRAPHIC_PROOF_REJECTED_V24
rule: Commitment range proof surjection proof opening proof or provider HMAC rejected.

name: WLN_STATUS_PROVIDER_BINDING_REJECTED_V24
rule: Signed provider row secret envelope public descriptor device epoch or storage qualification rejected.

name: WLN_STATUS_NO_VALID_PLAN_V24
rule: No finite balance change or synthetic-charge fixed point satisfies the exact request.

name: WLN_STATUS_CANCELLED_V24
rule: Cancellation observed at a documented safe point.

name: WLN_STATUS_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED_V24
rule: Monotonic deadline expired at a documented safe point.

name: WLN_STATUS_OUT_OF_MEMORY_V24
rule: Allocator returned NULL or checked size cannot be represented.

name: WLN_STATUS_IO_ERROR_V24
rule: Exact local provider retrieval or required allocator backing operation failed.

name: WLN_STATUS_INTERNAL_ERROR_V24
rule: Invariant failure; no retry or fallback implied.

name: WLN_STATUS_BUSY_V24
rule: Ordinary caller code found an active call live result or diagnostic owner or a RELEASING handle; caller-visible output bytes stay unchanged; callback-origin entry never uses BUSY.

name: WLN_STATUS_CALLBACK_PROTOCOL_ERROR_V24
rule: Cancellation returned 2 through 255 a language adapter contained an exception or any export was entered while the current thread was inside a caller callback.

name: wln_abi_get_descriptor_v24
rule: Callback-origin guard runs first and returns CALLBACK_PROTOCOL_ERROR with out_descriptor byte-identical; otherwise out_descriptor is required and initialized NULL and on success receives one immutable library-static descriptor.

name: wln_context_create_v24
rule: Callback-origin guard runs first and leaves outputs byte-identical; otherwise configuration includes exact release identity KERNEL_EXPERIMENT_ASSERTION_V1 PREPROVISIONED_CONFIDENTIALITY_PROVIDER_CONFIG_V1 and KERNEL_STATIC_NETWORK_POLICY_V1; all RID provider resources are finalized before a handle is published; out_handle starts invalid and failure may return a releasable diagnostic.

name: wln_context_release_v24
rule: Callback-origin entry returns CALLBACK_PROTOCOL_ERROR byte-identically; ordinary entry uses LIVE RELEASING CONSUMED: active owner or RELEASING returns BUSY; success performs no caller callback or diagnostic staging zeroizes bounded private state consumes and zeroes the handle; all-zero handle plus initialized diagnostic is idempotent OK.

name: wln_invoke_v24
rule: Callback-origin guard runs first and leaves all 160 out_result bytes byte-identical; otherwise input/context are borrowed and out_result uses WLN_RESULT_INIT_V24 and receives the only live output ownership.

name: wln_result_release_v24
rule: Callback-origin guard runs first and changes no bytes cookies or free count; otherwise prevalidates the complete result ownership group all-or-none; only an all-valid set is consumed freed and zeroed; complete all-zero succeeds.

name: wln_diagnostic_release_v24
rule: Callback-origin guard runs first and changes no bytes cookies or free count; otherwise prevalidates the complete standalone diagnostic ownership group all-or-none; canonical empty and complete all-zero succeed.

name: wln_abi_can_unload_v24
rule: Callback-origin guard runs first and leaves the output byte-identical; otherwise writes one only when this mapped-library generation has zero handles cookies calls callbacks release owners and provider prepublication owners; host must not unload on zero or call failure.

name: owner_cookie_registry
rule: Stale copied cross-library cross-generation unknown or type-confused cookies reject without freeing; no value-based fallback allocator lookup is legal.

name: atomic_release_group
rule: Every returned result or standalone diagnostic has one registry group id; buffers are field-bound and pairwise disjoint; nested result diagnostics cannot be released separately; validation and multi-cookie consume are atomic under one registry lock before any zero or free callback.

name: call_entry_ranges
rule: Create and invoke require checked aligned nonwrapping pairwise-disjoint context allocator borrowed-input and output-struct ranges before callback parse output initialization or write.

name: allocator_return_ranges
rule: Every callback allocation is aligned nonwrapping and disjoint from call-entry ranges and every live allocation; hostile overlap is never dereferenced freed registered or exposed.

name: diagnostic_zero_flags
rule: Every emitted diagnostic has flags zero and canonical-empty context; parsing a nonzero diagnostic flag is INVALID_ENCODING and releasing a live standalone or result-nested diagnostic with any nonzero flag is INVALID_ARGUMENT with bytes cookies registry and free count unchanged; zeroization of every nonempty capacity is unconditional and never selected by a flag.

name: provider_prepublication_owner
rule: One PROVIDER_PREPUBLICATION_OWNER_V1 exists before the first provider acquisition and remains unload-visible through ACQUIRING and CLEANING until every registered RID resource is finalized and the owner reaches SUCCEEDED or FAILED; no handle is published while it exists.

name: relative_timeout_clock
rule: Timeout is a bounded relative duration captured by native QueryPerformanceCounter CLOCK_MONOTONIC or mach_continuous_time; elapsed greater than or equal expires and clock regression fails closed.

name: library_unload
rule: Unloading executable bytes before wln_abi_can_unload_v24 returns OK and one is forbidden while LIVE or RELEASING handles callbacks calls cookies diagnostics release owners or provider prepublication owners exist.

name: native_provider_binding
rule: Fixed secret envelope and bounded public descriptor are bound to exact release-signed RID row handle generation device epoch record revision storage qualification experiment assertion static network policy and mapped library; only bounded native-private bytes remain after create; zero platform provider handles sessions references locators or response buffers remain; raw SLIP-77 keys ABFs and VBFs never cross the ABI and are zeroized before call return and handle release.

name: stateless_pipeline
rule: No request plan PSET proof phase replay cache nonce counter or advancing object is retained; deterministic domain-separated PRFs make identical valid bytes return identical success bytes within one live handle generation; failure changes no semantic state.

name: key_separation
rule: Operations 1 through 3 may derive only bounded read-only SLIP-77 unblinding material; no ABI operation can derive a spend-signing private key emit a signature finalize a spend or create a broadcast transaction.

name: recovery_fence
rule: Any imported restored migrated personal production or device-changed provider record rejects; v24 has no recovery path or spend authority and no chain observation changes that fact.

name: kernel_capabilities
rule: Ordinary wallet recovery production signing and multiparty transaction capabilities are all false; descriptor feature_flags are zero and no report manifest extension or configuration may claim otherwise.

name: invoke_outcome_classes
rule: PRE_DISPATCH_NO_WRITE leaves WLN_RESULT_INIT_V24 byte-identical and creates no release obligation; COMPLETED_OWNED_RESULT atomically publishes one legal operation-1-through-3 result and requires exactly one result release.

name: callback_domains
rule: Every export checks thread-local callback-origin depth before validation lookup output write registry or callback-domain acquisition and returns CALLBACK_PROTOCOL_ERROR for same/cross-handle entry; allocator and cancellation tuples remain separately serialized; the early guard prevents A-to-C/C-to-A acquisition while different top-level domains may run concurrently.

name: context_release_lifecycle
rule: LIVE RELEASING CONSUMED is the complete automaton; no provider close diagnostic allocation close-failed partial-close or retryable-close state exists; busy is retryable all-zero is idempotent and release performs zero caller callbacks on every RID.
